relative_difference_gate_definition: maximum pointwise |A-B|/max(|A|,|B|,1e-300) over the frozen native evaluation times
global_relative_L2: reported descriptively but not used to weaken the gate
spatial_derivative: analytic Fourier derivative on exact integer modes 3,5,8,10,15,20
time_evolution: complete common native trace history; no off-native time interpolation
primary_evaluation_grid: the eight common native times satisfying 0.2<=z<=1.5
x_rms_control: both Nx=256 and Nx=512, both quadrature runs, must reproduce the analytic NL1C0 band RMS within 1e-10
